name: AeroVision
description: AeroVision is een onafhankelijke inkoop adviseur van (geo)informatie. Wij maken uw inzet van geo-informatie bij besluitvorming effectiever.

name: Antea Group
description: Antea Group is een internationaal ingenieurs- en adviesbureau; gespecialiseerd in full-service oplossingen op het gebied van milieu, infrastructuur, stedenbouw en water.

name: Aratos Systems
description: Aratos Systems and Aratos Space, provide for an increasing range of added value products, services and solutions in the fields of Space & Satellites, Information & Communication, as well as Cyber Technology and Homeland Security.

name: Ellipsis Drive
description: We make your spatial data and analytics products as easy to manage, share and collaborate on as any text document in a regular drive. Ellipsis Drive converts uploaded spatial data files into beautiful live maps and web services.

name: GeoCat
description: GeoCat offers cutting-edge, customized software and services that make publishing geospatial data on the Internet easier and more efficient. Operating in the fast growing market of Spatial Data Infrastructure (SDI) and geospatial-enabled technologies.

name: Geonovum
description: Geonovum ontwikkelt de standaarden die nodig zijn om geo-informatie van de overheid toegankelijk en uitwisselbaar te maken. Ook helpen wij de overheid om geo-informatie beter te benutten, door haar te informeren over bestaande en nieuwe voorzieningen.

name: OptNet
description: OPT/NET B.V. builds comprehensive Mission Critical AI products for data-driven environments based on decades of hardcore critical industry experience.

name: Skylab Analystics
description: Skylab Analytics makes sense of space based imagery and data analytics technology for global businesses with global problems. We are an independent satellite data analytics company, without any revenue commitments to any satellite data provider. As such we will find the aerial or satellite data collection platform that is technically most suited to solve your problem, with no hidden commercial agenda. We work with several air/spaceborne data providers and sensor technologies.

name: SLTN
description: SLTN Ontzorgt ICT. Dat doen wij al meer dan 20 jaar met Passie, Kwaliteit en Innovatie. Met een omzet van ruim 150 miljoen euro behoren wij tot de grotere, niet beursgenoteerde IT bedrijven van Nederland en daar zijn we uitermate trots op!

name: Zuidt
description: Zuidt offers companies and governmental agencies help with building a robust and transparant infrastructure for their spatial data.
